name: matchaclaw
description: MatchaClaw - Graphical AI Assistant based on OpenClaw
author: MatchaClaw Team

scripts.init: pnpm install && pnpm run uv:download && pnpm run bun:download
scripts.build: node scripts/download-wiki-assets.mjs --check --platform win32 --arch x64 && pnpm run protoc:download && node scripts/download-matcha-ripgrep.mjs --arch x64 && node scripts/build-network-access.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64 && node scripts/build-runtime-host-native.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64 && pnpm run build:vite && pnpm run build:matcha-agent --arch x64 && zx scripts/bundle-openclaw.mjs && zx scripts/bundle-openclaw-plugins.mjs && zx scripts/bundle-preinstalled-skills.mjs && node scripts/bundle-searxng.mjs --target win32-x64 && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run check:e2e && pnpm run build:vite:e2e && pnpm --dir e2e test
scripts.test:e2e:headed: pnpm run check:e2e && pnpm run build:vite:e2e && pnpm --dir e2e test:headed
scripts.test:runtime-host:contract: cargo test --manifest-path runtime-host/Cargo.toml -p runtime-host --test module_boundary_contract --test module_platform_contract
scripts.git-bash:download:win: pnpm run git-bash:download:win:x64 && pnpm run git-bash:download:win:arm64
scripts.prep:win-x64-binaries: pnpm run uv:download:win:x64 && pnpm run bun:download:win:x64 && pnpm run git-bash:download:win:x64
